title: Talk at UIST'25
content: I will be presenting my paper, "MEDebiaser: A Human-AI Feedback System for Mitigating Bias in Multi-label Medical Image Classification," at UIST 2025 in Busan, South Korea, on Wednesday, October 1st, at 11:48 AM in Room Miami of the Paradise Hotel.

title: Paper Accepted by UIST'25
content: One paper was accepted by The 2025 ACM Symposium on User Interface Software and Technology (UIST'25)!

title: Paper Accepted by VIS'25
content: One paper was accepted by The 2025 IEEE Visualization and Visual Analytics Conference (VIS'25)!
